text: {"score":3,"justification":"Most numbers match the card and the leaning is appropriately cautious, but the headline overclaims and some narrative statements are unsupported or mismatched. The next steps are also generic and do not match the specific recommendations in the rationale.","problems":["Headline says 99215 is above expectation 'in every complexity stratum', but the by-complexity table compares to all-provider share, not expected; this wording is loose. The 0-condition stratum is only 4.3% vs 1.9%, which is a thin basis.","Rationale says C0004380 is 'upper respiratory infection'; the card shows only dx J06.9 with no chronic conditions. The diagnosis description is an inference, though J06.9 does map to URI.","Claims 'even the low-complexity claim C0004639 has high MDM documented'; C0004639 is on the low-complexity list and in the supported examples, so this is correct, but the minutes are 'not recorded', which the summary only partly addresses.","Claims it 'points to a provider-level billing habit rather than panel acuity alone', which is stronger than the cautious 'inconclusive' leaning supports.","The headline says documented 99215 charts all support billed level, based on only 6 charts; the summary acknowledges this, but the headline still leans on it.","Formal cited_claim_ids and examples (C0004265, C0004300) are generic osteoarthritis/hyperlipidemia claims, not the ones the narrative highlights (C0004380, C0004477, C0004529, C0004623); the citations don't match the narrative's examples.","Next steps are generic: they ask for a larger sample of 99214/99215 records and a re-screen, rather than the specific chart requests for the low-complexity 99215 claims named in the rationale; no step addresses the templated-notes or time-documentation checks.","Rationale is lengthy and repeats itself (the 0 below-billed finding and the thin sample are stated twice)."]}
